purpose: A skip is green. Without this file a GPU grader that has never run on any host and a GPU grader that ran and passed are the same colour, and nothing anywhere records which one happened. Each entry states when its grader last actually produced a number, on what host, against which commit, and what the number was. A null last_observed means the grader has never been observed producing a number - that is a real finding, not a blank.
maintenance: Running the GPU graders rewrites this file in place. Commit the change; it is the receipt. Nothing regenerates it on a host without an accelerator, which is exactly why the recorded commit and host are part of the entry.
